title.rendered: Banan Real Estate Company announces the appointment of a market maker for the company’s shares

content.rendered:
We are pleased to announce the appointment of a market maker for Banan Real Estate Co.’s shares, marking the start of another successful partnership. The Saudi Arabia Real Estate Market is estimated at $69.51 billion in 2024 and is expected to reach $101.62 billion by 2029, growing at a CAGR of 8% during this period.

View More
